profile.name: David Elias Carrasco
profile.specialized: Specialized in .NET, Vue 3, Cloud & Software Architecture
profile.summary1: Software Engineer specialized in the design, development, evolution, and comprehensive modernization of mission-critical enterprise applications, backed by solid expertise in scalable cloud architectures, applied Artificial Intelligence, and high-performance full-stack engineering.
profile.summary2: Currently at NTT DATA delivering solutions for Ecoembes, where I actively contribute to the software lifecycle through the development of new features and the evolutionary and corrective maintenance of legacy systems. The platform's core architecture relies on a robust ecosystem built with .NET for backend services, Oracle relational databases for complex data persistence, and Vue 3 to deliver a modern, fluid frontend user experience. Additionally, I drive the exploration and hands-on implementation of cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and Agentic AI technologies, optimizing internal workflows and accelerating technical innovation across the business.
